title: A named church is told to gather and build at Far West
setting: Joseph Smith dictated this revelation at Far West, Missouri, on 26 April 1838. He had moved there from Kirtland in March, after dissent divided the Church in Ohio. Thousands of Saints lived in and around Far West, and hundreds more were on the way. Members had begun digging a temple foundation in 1837, but leaders paused the work until the Lord’s will was known. George W. Robinson copied the revelation into Joseph’s journal.
summary: The revelation addresses the First Presidency, Bishop Edward Partridge, the high council in Zion, and all members. It gives the Church its name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. It calls the Saints to “arise and shine forth” as a standard for the nations. Gathering to Zion and her stakes is to be a defense and a refuge. Far West is declared holy, and a house of worship is to be built there. Work is to begin on 4 July, following a pattern shown to the presidency. Joseph, Sidney Rigdon, and Hyrum Smith must not go further into debt to build it. Far West is to grow quickly, and Joseph will name other stakes nearby.

contextNote.title: A name that carries a duty
contextNote.text: Before 1838 the Church had used other names, including the Church of Christ and the Church of the Latter Day Saints. Verse 4 settles the matter with one name for “the last days”. The name joins two claims: the church belongs to Jesus Christ, and its members are latter-day saints. Verse 3 shows who carries the name, the “elders and people” scattered in all the world. Verse 5 then gives the named people a task, to be “a standard for the nations”. In this passage, the name is an identity that comes with a public duty.

ldsText: The 2025 Come, Follow Me lesson for sections 115–120 notes that the Lord named His Church in verse 4. How do verses 5–6 describe what the people who bear that name are to do for others?
reviewNote: Read all 19 verses. Official heading gives Far West, 26 April 1838, and the naming of the Church. JSP historical introduction read for the 1837 excavation and pause, Joseph's March 1838 move, growth of Far West, the earlier name Church of Christ, Robinson's copy, and cornerstones laid 4 July 1838. The 1834 name Church of the Latter Day Saints is from general knowledge, not the JSP page.
